events.summary: The Tern T2 October 2026 build is not clear. Of 134 bought parts needed for 182 robots, 35 are covered by dated supply landing in the month, 13 arrive after October, 3 are past due, 3 are under Shenzhen Yunzhan Precision Motor's force-majeure notice (HR-40110, HR-40130, HR-40120, which are not counted as arriving), and 80 have no open order, so they are unknown without a stock count, not covered.

recommendation.finding: No, the Tern T2 October build is not clear. Of the parts needed for 182 robots, 35 are covered by dated supply landing in October and 13 arrive after the build. Three are past due, mostly on the Chassis (two parts from one supplier, 29 and 28 days late) and one on the Sensor mast. Three drive and lift parts are under Shenzhen Yunzhan Precision Motor's force majeure, and 80 have no open order, so they are unknown until someone counts stock. Next: chase the past-due Chassis lines, get revised dates from Shenzhen Yunzhan, and have the five buyers confirm stock.
